<!-- Adding or updating a parts library? Tick each box. -->

**Library:** <!-- name, and a link to its repository -->

- [ ] The manifest is at `libraries/<my GitHub account>/<library>.json` (or my organisation's folder), and its `id` is `<publisher>.<library>`.
- [ ] `repo` is a public GitHub repository owned by the publisher, and `release` names a published release, its `.zip` asset and the asset's SHA-256.
- [ ] The zip unpacks to a folder the SolidCraft Parts Library panel can show (designs, STEP or mesh files), with no programs or scripts in it.
- [ ] I opened the library in SolidCraft `min_solidcraft` or later and the parts insert.
- [ ] `license` is the library's SPDX licence, and I have the right to share every part under it.
- [ ] The parts are my own work or used under their licence: nothing copied from a vendor's CAD downloads without permission. ([CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/tangency-labs/solidcraft-parts/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md))
- [ ] `tier` is `"unverified"`.
